nd5f5d8b463.headline: Popularity of foreign e-shops is growing. Czechs often shop in German or Slovak ones
nd5f5d8b463.summary: Czech consumers spent 41.8 billion crowns abroad last year, a 41% increase, mainly in German and Slovak online shops and travel bookings.
nd5f5d8b463.why: Rising cross-border e-commerce reflects consumer behavior shifts and impacts domestic retail sectors.

n01980f9830.headline: How Iran continues to defy the United States with its arms program
n01980f9830.summary: Iran successfully launched a cruise missile from a Ghadir-class submarine during naval exercises near the Strait of Hormuz.
n01980f9830.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical oil shipping route; military activity there can affect global energy markets and geopolitical risk.
n01980f9830.why_moved: Iran's missile test near a vital oil shipping lane increased geopolitical tensions, causing oil price volatility.
